title: PARTY CARD PROMPT IS 24PX, WITH A FOOTER RULE
why: The critic scored the party cards 3 after v31.68: the press any key prompt is the primary action but draws at 20px, the size of the table text, and the card has no footer row. The prompt is now 24px with a 32px glyph, and a hairline above the footer row gives header, body, footer. Restyle only.
now: The press any key prompt on the how to play page, the board and the run over card is 24px with a footer rule above it.
